title: CRA Evidence Bundle
description: Machine-readable structure for the Minimum CRA Evidence Bundle defined in proposals/continuous-reliability-assurance-for-financial-ai.md, section 3. Encodes the six minimum artifacts, the A-E trigger taxonomy from section 2, the materiality classes, and the ownership split required by section 5. This schema is illustrative reference material, not normative standards text.

bundle_id.description: Stable identifier for this reassessment, e.g. CRA-2026-07-001.

schema_version.description: Version of this bundle schema the record was written against.

system.description: Identification and classification of the live AI system under reassessment.

use_case.description: Free text. Section 8 discusses credit decisioning, fraud detection, AML monitoring, LLM assistants and agentic systems.

system_class.description: Monitoring requirements by system class, per section 6.

autonomy_level.description: Autonomy acts as a threshold multiplier. Section 4 notes the same decline may justify review in a decision-support system but restriction in an autonomous action workflow.

impact_tier.description: Proportionality of CRA depth, per the applicability design principle.

trigger_record.description: Minimum artifact 1: shows why reassessment was opened.

category.description: Trigger categories A-E as defined in section 2.

materiality.description: Predefined materiality class per the Trigger Materiality Rules in section 2.

detection_source.description: Detectability is one of the threshold design factors in section 4.

delta_description.description: Minimum artifact 2: defines what changed since the last accepted state.

duration.description: Duration of degradation, a threshold design factor in section 4.

change_records.description: Change evidence per section 3: retraining summaries, prompt or retrieval change logs, vendor update notices, dependency changes.

reliability_impact_analysis.description: Minimum artifact 3: connects the observed change to continued acceptability.

customer_financial_impact.description: Customer or financial impact, a threshold design factor in section 4.

compensating_controls.description: Availability of compensating controls, a threshold design factor in section 4.

root_cause.description: Required by section 3 where deterioration is observed.

monitoring_snapshot.description: Minimum artifact 4: shows live operating behaviour at reassessment time, per section 6.

monitoring_intact.description: False where a monitoring outage or logging failure is itself part of the trigger, per category D.

decision_record.description: Minimum artifacts 5 and 6: the control decision and its accountable sign-off.

decision.description: Control decision options from stage 5 of the CRA operating model.

recorded_escalation_level.description: Escalation level 1-5 recorded by the institution, per section 4. The evaluator compares its own recommendation against this value.

governance_forum_notified.description: Section 4 level 4 requires notification of relevant governance forums.

ownership.description: Section 5 requires deliberate separation of responsibilities. CRA should not collapse into a single-owner model.
